name: Grand staircase pose
editorial: A candid high-fashion editorial photograph, relaxed elegance.
body: standing on a middle step of the staircase, weight on the back leg, torso turned a little toward the camera, spine long.
head: chin slightly lowered, looking down into the lens.
pose: one hand resting lightly on the banister, the other holding the skirt or hanging easily, one foot on a higher step.
